Switzerland U17 vs Mexico U17: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a decisive group stage match in the FIFA U-17 World Cup, where the Switzerland U17 national team faces Mexico U17. For both teams, this contest will be pivotal in the fight for a spot in the knockout stages, with Switzerland needing only a draw, while Mexico must win.

Kick-off: November 10, 2025, 12:30 UTC 15:30 MSK Stadium: Brann Stadion, Bergen (neutral venue) Competition: FIFA U-17 World Cup

Switzerland U17 vs Mexico U17: Match Preview

The teams approach this decisive encounter in different moods. Switzerland has confidently navigated the group stage, thrashing Ivory Coast 4:1 and drawing 0:0 with South Korea, leading their group. Mexico, a youth football powerhouse, started with a loss to Korea but bounced back with a narrow 1:0 win over Ivory Coast, keeping their playoff hopes alive. This match is a rematch of the 2009 World Cup final, where Switzerland claimed a historic 2:0 victory.

Team Form and Analysis

Switzerland U17

Massimo Rizzo's side has been impressive with disciplined and organized play, conceding just one goal in two matches. The 'Nati' rely on ball control, compact defense, and swift counter-attacks. The team is unbeaten in several matches, showing mental stability. The attacking leader is Adrien Llukes, known for scoring crucial goals.

Mexico U17

Carlos Cariño's Mexico has struggled for consistency in this tournament, showing mixed performances. 'El Tri' have lost three of their last four matches, raising concerns. The team commits many fouls and accumulates yellow cards, showing defensive instability. Mexico must push forward to win, which could leave gaps for Switzerland's quick counter-attacks.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Switzerland U17 4-4-2: Pizarro; Mambwa, Zufferey, Sadikaj, Lebre; Bruchez, Llukes, Mijailovic, Koloto; Scherrer, Schaller.
  • Mexico U17 4-4-2: Rodriguez; Chavarria, Ojeda, Contreras, D'Gomez; Cibrian, Torres, Lopez, Ortega; Carrillo, de Nigris Gonzalez.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

While bookmakers slightly favor Switzerland, the match is expected to be highly tense. Mexico must attack and take risks, while Switzerland can rely on their organization and play for a draw.

  • Main Prediction: Switzerland to Win or Draw 1X. The Swiss team’s organization and composure, along with their favorable table position, suggest they should at least avoid defeat against an inconsistent but motivated opponent.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. A decisive group match where the cost of mistakes is high is unlikely to produce many goals. Both sides have shown modest attacking output in this tournament.

Korea Republic U17 vs Côte d'Ivoire U17: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a FIFA U-17 World Cup group stage match in Qatar, featuring representatives of two different football continents and philosophies - the Korea Republic and Côte d'Ivoire. This match promises to be a fascinating tactical battle.

Kick-off: November 10, 2025, 12:30 UTC 15:30 MSK Stadium: Aspire Zone - Pitch 8, Doha Competition: FIFA U-17 World Cup

Korea Republic U17 vs Côte d'Ivoire U17: Match Preview

For both teams, this match will be a crucial step in the fight for qualification from the group. South Korea, finalists of the last AFC U-17 Asian Cup, traditionally represents one of the strongest teams in Asia, relying on discipline, stamina, and teamwork. Côte d'Ivoire, on the other hand, is a typical representative of the African school of football, where physical strength, speed, and individual skill come first. This will be the first-ever official meeting between these two nations at the U-17 level, adding an element of unpredictability.

Team Form and Analysis

Korea Republic U17

The 'Young Taeguk Warriors' are known for their tactical organization and exceptional work rate. Korean youth teams are famous for their compact defense and rapid, precise counter-attacks. Key players are typically agile wingers and creative midfielders. The team will aim to dictate the game's tempo and take advantage of fast transitions.

Côte d'Ivoire U17

The 'Little Elephants' pose a strong physical challenge thanks to their athleticism. Ivorian players are quick, powerful, and aggressive in duels. The team focuses on wing play and physical dominance. However, lapses in tactical discipline can be their weak point - something the organized Korean side will aim to exploit.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Korea Republic U17 4-2-3-1: Kim Hyun-min; Lee Chang-woo, Hong Young-min, Kang Min-woo, Bae Seong-ho; Jeon Hyun-jin, Park Seung-soo; Kim Do-yoon, Yoon Do-yong, Yang Min-hyuk; Lee Jae-hwan.
  • Côte d'Ivoire U17 4-3-3: Kone; Coulibaly, Traoré, Diallo, Konaté; Fofana, Sangaré, Kessié; Adingra, Diakité, Bamba.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A clash of structure versus strength. Korean discipline will meet Ivorian power and pace. The outcome depends on which philosophy prevails.

  • Main Prediction: Draw. Both sides may cancel each other out - Korea's defensive organization could resist Côte d'Ivoire's attacking bursts.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Youth World Cup group-stage matches are often cautious and low-scoring, especially when equally matched teams meet.

Colombia U17 vs Korea DPR U17: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the final round of the FIFA U-17 World Cup group stage, where Colombia faces the mysterious team from North Korea. This match will be crucial for both sides in their pursuit of a knockout stage berth.

Kick-off: November 10, 2025, 13:30 UTC 16:30 MSK Stadium: Aspire Zone - Pitch 6, Doha Competition: FIFA U-17 World Cup

Colombia U17 vs Korea DPR U17: Match Preview

Both teams need points to keep their qualification hopes alive. Colombia, finalists of the last South American U-17 Championship, are one of the most technical and creative sides in the tournament. DPR Korea, on the other hand, are the dark horse - known for their discipline, endurance, and teamwork. This is the first-ever official meeting between these teams at the U-17 level, adding to the unpredictability.

Team Form and Analysis

Colombia U17

'Los Cafeteros,' led by Freddy Hurtado, play the typical South American style - technical, ball-controlled, and expressive in attack. They aim to dominate early, press high, and exploit defensive gaps. The main attacking weapon is striker Santiago Londoño, one of the top scorers in qualification. However, defensive instability remains a concern.

Korea DPR U17

The North Korean side remains one of the most enigmatic in the tournament. The 'Chollima' are renowned for their tactical rigidity, physical conditioning, and defensive unity. Expect them to sit deep, stay compact, and counter with pace. Despite their lack of individual brilliance, their cohesion and discipline make them a dangerous opponent.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Colombia U17 4-2-3-1: Mendoza; Macias, Herazo, Garcia, Zapata; Orozco, Mora; Florez, Quiñones, Sevillano; Londoño.
  • Korea DPR U17 5-4-1: Jong Nam; Il Bom, Kwang Song, Chol Min, Jin Hyok, Jin Song; Song Hyok, Yong Jin, Kyong Sok, Yong Hyok; Il Song.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A duel of South American skill against Asian discipline. Colombia should have the upper hand due to their attacking quality, but DPR Korea's defensive structure could make this a tight encounter.

  • Main Prediction: Colombia to Win. Their technical advantage and attacking variety should break down DPR Korea's compact defense.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. DPR Korea will likely defend deep, making it difficult for Colombia to create multiple clear chances, resulting in a low-scoring match.

El Salvador U17 vs Germany U17: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the final round of the FIFA U-17 World Cup group stage in Group G, where El Salvador faces the reigning world champions, Germany. For the German team, this match will be decisive in their fight for a playoff spot, while for the Salvadorans, it's a chance to make a bold statement.

Kick-off: November 10, 2025, 13:30 UTC 16:30 MSK Stadium: Aspire Zone - Pitch 5, Doha Competition: FIFA U-17 World Cup

El Salvador U17 vs Germany U17: Match Preview

The teams approach this match with different objectives. Germany, the defending world champions, surprisingly started the tournament with two draws, putting the team in a difficult position – they need a victory to secure a place in the knockout rounds. El Salvador, after a draw and a loss, has nearly lost all chances of advancing and will play for pride. This will be the first-ever official meeting between these nations at U-17 level, adding an element of unpredictability.

Team Form and Analysis

El Salvador U17

The Central American side shows spirit but lacks the quality and experience needed for consistent performances on the world stage. The team relies on a structured defense and determination. Against the world champions, they are likely to sit deep, focus on compact defending, and hope for rare counterattacks or set-piece opportunities.

Germany U17

Germany will be highly motivated after two disappointing draws. The squad is among the strongest in the tournament but hasn’t yet lived up to its full potential. The 'Bundes-team' is expected to dominate possession, control the tempo, and put constant pressure on their opponents. The attacking leaders, who have yet to shine, are expected to step up. The lack of victories will force the Germans to stay focused and aggressive from the start.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • El Salvador U17 5-4-1: Colorado; Vasquez, Orellana, Cruz, Melendez, Ramirez; Acosta, Alvarado, Diaz, Hernandez; Montoya.
  • Germany U17 4-3-3: Heide; da Silva, Jeltsch, Odogu, Kabar; Harchaoui, Darvich, Herrmann; Brunner, Moerstedt, Osawe.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Germany is the overwhelming favorite for this matchup. The difference in quality, motivation, and the need to redeem themselves after a slow start make a German victory almost inevitable. El Salvador will find it extremely difficult to withstand one of the tournament’s top teams.

  • Main Prediction: Germany to Win with a -2.5 Handicap. After two draws, the world champions are expected to secure a dominant win against the underdog to ensure progression and improve goal difference.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Germany’s Individual Total Over 3 Goals. The German attack is due to explode, and this match against a modest opponent is the ideal occasion.

Honduras U17 vs Indonesia U17: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the final Group H match of the FIFA U-17 World Cup, where Honduras faces Indonesia. This is a true do-or-die match, as both teams lost their first two games and now need a big victory to keep hopes alive of advancing as one of the best third-placed teams.

Kick-off: November 10, 2025, 14:45 UTC 17:45 MSK Stadium: Aspire Zone - Pitch 2, Doha Competition: FIFA U-17 World Cup

Honduras U17 vs Indonesia U17: Match Preview

Both sides enter this match desperate for points after losing to Brazil and Zambia. Honduras sits bottom of the group with a -10 goal difference following 0-7 and 2-5 defeats. Indonesia, with a -6 goal difference, ranks third after losses of 1-3 and 0-4. With Brazil and Zambia already through, both teams can only hope to qualify as one of the best third-placed sides - and to do that, they need a big win. This will be their first-ever official U-17 meeting.

Team Form and Analysis

Honduras U17

'Los Catrachos' have shown very weak defending, conceding 12 goals in two games. The team struggled against both the Brazilians' skill and Zambia's physicality. Despite scoring twice, their defensive structure remains a major problem, which could cost them dearly in this high-stakes match.

Indonesia U17

The 'Young Garudas,' led by Nova Arianto, also suffered two losses but were more organized. Against Zambia they even took the lead, though lost focus later. The game versus Brazil exposed their technical gap, but Indonesia's superior organization and goal difference give them a slight edge heading into this match.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Honduras U17 4-4-2: Duran; Hernandez, Valladares, Sanchez, Garcia; Martinez, Alvarado, Ortiz, Rivera; Arrieta, Rocha.
  • Indonesia U17 4-3-3: Iskandar; Arianto, Prasetyo, Kwateh, Aszwari; Arhan, Iqbal, Brillian; Fikri, Sulaeman, Zahaby.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Both sides have no choice but to attack. This should lead to an open, high-scoring encounter.

  • Main Prediction: Indonesia to Win. The Southeast Asian side looks more balanced and organized than Honduras, whose defense has been disastrous.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 3.5 Goals. Both teams must score heavily to improve goal difference, making a goal-filled match highly likely.

Zambia U17 vs Brazil U17: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the final Group H match of the FIFA U-17 World Cup, featuring Zambia and Brazil - the two leaders of the group. This match will decide the top spot and could provide an easier opponent in the knockout rounds.

Kick-off: November 10, 2025, 14:45 UTC 17:45 MSK Stadium: Aspire Zone - Pitch 7, Doha Competition: FIFA U-17 World Cup

Zambia U17 vs Brazil U17: Match Preview

Both sides have already qualified for the knockout stage after winning their first two games. Brazil leads the group with a superior goal difference (+11 vs +5). The 'Seleção' crushed Honduras 7-0 and Indonesia 4-0, maintaining a perfect defensive record. Zambia, debuting at the World Cup, impressed with victories over Indonesia 3-1 and Honduras 5-2. This will be their first-ever official meeting at the U-17 level.

Team Form and Analysis

Zambia U17

The 'Young Chipolopolo' have been one of the biggest surprises of the tournament, showing athletic, high-tempo football and scoring 8 goals so far. However, their defense remains vulnerable, conceding three times in two matches. Against Brazil's attack, maintaining a clean sheet will be a tough challenge.

Brazil U17

Brazil, as usual, are the heavy favorites. The 'Seleção' play entertaining, technical, and attacking football, scoring 11 goals without conceding. Packed with young talent already attracting European scouts, they might rotate players, but quality remains top-level across the squad.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Zambia U17 4-4-2: Munyao; Musonda, Chanda, Mweene, Banda; Kapumbu, Ngoma, Mutale, Chilufya; Lungu, Daka.
  • Brazil U17 4-2-3-1: Phellipe; Arthur, Da Mata, Eduardo, Esquerdinha; Dudu, Luis Gustavo; Guilherme, Rayan, Lorran; Elias.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite Zambia's strong start, Brazil are the clear favorites due to their superior skill and experience. Expect goals and open play from both sides.

  • Main Prediction: Brazil to Win. Even with rotation, the South Americans should secure first place in the group.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 3.5 Goals. Both teams have been highly productive, making a high-scoring encounter very likely.

Venezuela U17 vs Haiti U17: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a FIFA U-17 World Cup group stage match in Qatar, featuring representatives of two Americas - the South American team, Venezuela, and the CONCACAF representative, Haiti. For both teams, this match will be a crucial step in the fight for qualification from the group.

Kick-off: November 10, 2025, 15:45 UTC (18:45 MSK) Stadium: Aspire Zone - Pitch 4, Doha Competition: FIFA U-17 World Cup

Venezuela U17 vs Haiti U17: Match Preview

Both teams approach this match needing to pick up points. Venezuela, which finished fourth in the South American qualifiers, is traditionally a strong and technical team. Haiti, on the other hand, is one of the most athletic and physically powerful teams in its region. This will be the first-ever official meeting between these two nations at the U-17 level, making it completely unpredictable.

Team Form and Analysis

Venezuela U17

'La Vinotinto' relies on ball control, combination play, and high individual skill. South American teams have always been known for their technique, and Venezuela is no exception. A player to watch in the squad is forward David Martínez, who was one of the top scorers in the qualifying tournament. The Venezuelans will aim to dominate from the first minutes and use their strengths in attack.

Haiti U17

The 'Grenadiers' are, first and foremost, about physical power, speed, and stamina. Teams from the Caribbean are always distinguished by their athleticism, and Haiti is a prime example. The team will rely on fast wing play and physical battles. The Haitians' weak point could be their tactical discipline, which their more organized opponents will try to exploit.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Venezuela U17 (4-2-3-1): Sánchez; Granados, Ramos, Bourguillones, Hernández; Díaz, Giménez; Arreaza, Reinoso, Urbano; Martínez.
  • Haiti U17 (4-3-3): Destine; Alcéus, Lafleur, Morné, Dumas; Constant, Joseph, St-Jean; Désir, Léveque, Marcelin.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

This is a classic clash of South American flair versus Caribbean power. Venezuela is the favorite on paper due to the higher individual class of its players and tactical training. However, underestimating the athletic and fast Haitian team, which is capable of imposing a physical battle, is a big mistake.

  • Main Prediction: Venezuela to Win. Technical superiority and a more diverse attacking game should help the Venezuelans break down the opponent's defense and secure a victory.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Matches at youth tournaments are often high-scoring. Venezuela will play attacking football, and Haiti is dangerous on the counter. An open game with plenty of goals can be expected.
